candidates.title: Anthropic Restores Claude Fable 5 with Nationality-Based Access and Biometric Controls
candidates.description: Following a six-day emergency government shutdown, Anthropic restored access to its frontier model Claude Fable 5. In compliance with the U.S. Commerce Department's directive, the release introduces strict, first-of-its-kind nationality-based access controls and biometric/ID identity verification for API users.
candidates.significance: This marks the first time a frontier AI model has been subjected to export-control-like restrictions down to the citizenship of the end-user, creating a new regime of sovereign and nationality-based access for advanced software.

candidates.title: US Regulators Fast-Track Power Grid Access for AI Data Centers
candidates.description: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) voted unanimously to direct regional grid operators to fast-track connections for AI data centers to the U.S. transmission system. The decision aims to secure U.S. AI infrastructure leadership against China, supported by major tech companies signing a 'Ratepayer Protection Pledge' to build or buy new power sources.
candidates.significance: This landmark policy shift addresses the energy bottleneck of AI scaling, accelerating power grid access for AI data centers and formally linking power grid regulation to national AI competitiveness.

candidates.title: Grassroots Group 'Humans First' Organizes Nationwide Protests Against AI Data Centers
candidates.description: The grassroots group 'Humans First' organized a Nationwide Day of Protest scheduled for July 18, 2026, targeting hyperscale AI data centers across 13 locations in states like Virginia, Texas, Georgia, Florida, and California. Protesters are raising concerns about grid strain, water consumption, noise, and zoning.
candidates.significance: This marks a major escalation in public backlash against physical AI infrastructure, indicating growing grassroots resistance to the resource footprint of LLM scaling.

candidates.title: Senator Bernie Sanders Introduces American AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Act
candidates.description: Senator Bernie Sanders introduced a bill to establish a $7 trillion national sovereign wealth fund funded by a one-time 50% stock tax on major AI companies. The bill proposes distributing a 5% annual dividend—approximately $1,000 per year—to every American citizen, and creating an independent commission with board-voting shares to oversee democratic AI development.
candidates.significance: This is the first major federal legislative proposal aiming to build a massive national sovereign wealth fund through corporate equity redistribution of the AI sector, marking a turning point in public policy debates on AI wealth distribution.
